blocks.en: There are various other orthogonal polynomials with specific names, e.g., Jacobi and Gegenbauer polynomials. We leave it to the reader to verify the orthogonality of the Chebyshev, Hermite and Laguerre polynomials; see Problem~\ref{ex:classical-polynomials-orthogonality-normalization}. There are numerous facts known about orthogonal polynomials, e.g., formulas for their coefficients, ``generating functions,'' differential equations which orthogonal polynomials satisfy, recursion relations and relationships to various special functions. We shall not discuss these issues here and instead refer to the literature.
blocks.zh: 还有其他各种具有专门名称的正交多项式, 例如 Jacobi 和 Gegenbauer 多项式. Chebyshev, Hermite 和 Laguerre 多项式的正交性留给读者验证; 见 Problem~\ref{ex:classical-polynomials-orthogonality-normalization}. 关于正交多项式已有许多已知事实, 例如系数公式, ``生成函数'', 正交多项式满足的微分方程, 递推关系以及与各种特殊函数的联系. 这里不讨论这些问题, 请参阅有关文献.

blocks.en: (see Problem~\ref{ex:laguerre-hermite-completeness-details}); hence the series in \eqref{eq:laguerre-polynomial-generating-function} converges also in $L_w^2(0,\infty)$ if $|t|<1$. It follows that any function $e^{-\alpha x}$, $\alpha>-1/2$, can be approximated in $L_w^2(0,\infty)$ by Laguerre polynomials. However, if $f\in L_w^2$ is orthogonal to $e^{-\alpha x}$ for every $\alpha$, then the Laplace transform of $f$ is zero, and therefore $f$ is zero. Hence linear combinations of exponentials $e^{-\alpha x}$ are dense in $L_w^2(0,\infty)$.
blocks.zh: (见 Problem~\ref{ex:laguerre-hermite-completeness-details}); 因而当 $|t|<1$ 时, \eqref{eq:laguerre-polynomial-generating-function} 中的级数也在 $L_w^2(0,\infty)$ 中收敛. 由此可得, 任意函数 $e^{-\alpha x}$, $\alpha>-1/2$, 都可在 $L_w^2(0,\infty)$ 中由 Laguerre 多项式逼近. 然而, 若 $f\in L_w^2$ 对每个 $\alpha$ 都与 $e^{-\alpha x}$ 正交, 则 $f$ 的 Laplace 变换为零, 从而 $f$ 为零. 因而指数函数 $e^{-\alpha x}$ 的线性组合在 $L_w^2(0,\infty)$ 中稠密.
